QuestInfo.name: Hello Henesys!
QuestInfo.0: You reached #m100000000#. There are people... everywhere.
QuestInfo.1: It would be safest to try and blend in with the crowd. Talk to the #boldest resident#k of #m100000000# to find out how you should act. That would most likely be #bChief Stan#k.
QuestInfo.2: You decide to ask #p1012003# about human behavior.

0.0: So, this is Henesys. I think we might stand out a little bit here. Maybe we oughtta go incognito. I mean, incog-neato!\r\n#L0##bHow do I blend in? I am covered in lights.#l\n#k
0.1: You do sort of look like the future... but just act natural. I'm sure these folks see protoype robot fighters all the time! Maybe somebody could even help us out.

yes.0: I think you oughtta find the #bperson who's lived in this town the longest#k. I bet THEY'D know how to blend in and be ignored!

no.0: Nobody can live on their own. You gotta make friends to get along!

1.0: Oh great, another prototype robot fighter... \r\n#L0##b(Roo-D was right!) Pardon me, sir, but have you lived in #m100000000# the longest?#l\n#k
1.1: What? What kinda idiotic question is that? I'm the Chief! You wanna know about #m100000000#, you come to me.

npc.0: This old man is obviously insane. I should find someone else.
